name: Can I repair a leaking window myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a leaking window myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: For minor leaks caused by superficial issues like small gaps in caulk or worn weatherstripping, you might be able to perform a DIY repair. However, if the leak source is unclear, involves frame damage, or has led to water intrusion into walls, it's best to hire a professional. Professionals have the experience and tools to accurately diagnose complex problems and ensure a lasting, effective repair, preventing further, more costly damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can DIY minor leaks from small caulk gaps or worn weatherstripping. For unclear sources, frame damage, or wall intrusion, hire a professional for accurate diagnosis and lasting repair.
